methodological_rigor.justification: The normalized file contains only the title, '[Retracted] MSK1 downregulation is associated with neuronal and astrocytic apoptosis following subarachnoid hemorrhage in rats,' and no abstract, methods, results, or statistical analysis. With no report of design, endpoints, or analysis, methodological rigor and statistical appropriateness cannot be evaluated from the manuscript text.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: The title identifies a rat model of subarachnoid hemorrhage, which places the work in the preclinical/basic-science category. Because the file contains no body text and is explicitly labeled retracted, the clinical or translational relevance cannot be meaningfully assessed from the manuscript itself.

reporting_quality.justification: An animal study would ordinarily be judged against ARRIVE, but the normalized file contains no experimental methods, animal handling details, or reporting checklist elements. No data-sharing or code-sharing information is present, so reproducibility cannot be assessed.

novelty_literature.justification: Only the title is present, so there is no introduction or results section to establish a novel mechanism or experimental finding. The retraction label also prevents any credible originality assessment.

writing_presentation.justification: There is no evaluable prose beyond the title, so clarity, organization, and presentation quality cannot be judged. The normalized manuscript is insufficient for a writing assessment.
